scope: Exact saved historical alignment display replay. No fitting, no new mask construction, no condition-result recomputation. Historical identifiers and groups remain historical context.
coordinate_formula: x_aligned = sign_x * (x_native - saved_center_x); y_aligned = sign_y * (y_native - saved_center_y)
coordinate_units: HALO export units; physical calibration unverified
display_grid_semantics: Saved native positions are bin centers, not individual object centroids. Counts are unchanged. n_all>0 is object occupancy, not strict tissue coverage.
layer_order_meaning: Home cage then Running; display order only, not serial-section order

alignment_check.caption: All 12 sections have inspectable proposals. Cross = cavity anchor. Flips are geometric suggestions, not anatomical approvals. Cropped edges do not move the anchor; remaining shape differences may reflect section level, tissue loss or imperfect landmarks.

extraction.method: JSONDecoder.raw_decode after the original explorer const root / DATA marker
